name: Flask
description: Be they wise alchemists or wrathful bombardiers, those who seek to know the materials of this world are less subtle in war than they are in research.

abilities.name: Easy Toss
abilities.description: Thrown/natural projectile attacks not affecting living targets are unaffected by Stamina tax. May pair thrown flasks with any weapon. Use Might instead of Grace for ranged attacks.

abilities.name: Chemical Warfare
abilities.description: Gain +1 Stash pool and know three common/uncommon flask recipes.

abilities.name: Controlled Burst
abilities.description: Increase flask terrain radius by one, targeted flasks become 3x3 AoE. Can ignore allies/spaces in effect radius up to Flask Rank.

abilities.name: Efficient Reagents
abilities.description: When creating Stash item, roll 1d6 - success refunds 1 Stash. +1 max Stash, learn two new common/uncommon flask recipes.

abilities.name: Chemical Admixture
abilities.description: Combine two non-Rare flasks (Carrier + Payload). Apply Payload effects to all targets/areas affected by Carrier. +1 max Stash, learn two new flasks of any rarity.
